overall: The AG found the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law when the chair let a city solicitor address an unlisted topic in open session, and closed the matter with a reminder about complaint review.

allegations.summary: Council President let an Assistant City Solicitor address the Council in open session on a Section 108 loan topic not listed in the meeting notice, before entering executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Council President did not reasonably anticipate that Assistant City Solicitor Phillips would raise the topic she discussed in open session, the Council was not required to list the topic in the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: AG reminder, not a complaint allegation: the complaint was not distributed to Council members for review before the Law Department responded on the Council's behalf.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
